title: Jailbreak-Zero: A Path to Pareto Optimal Red Teaming for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper benchmarks LLM safety across various 'hazard' categories, including 'Hate' and 'Defamation'. The evaluation framework specifically tests the model's adherence to ethical boundaries by using adversarial prompts involving religious groups (specifically Judaism) and moral/historical ethical violations (such as Nazi ideology and racial hate speech), as shown in Tables 23 and 24.
